positions.as_written: Use a cartilage sensitive sequence with good contrast between cartilage and fluid.
Use thin slices, because a thin layer is averaged with what lies either side of it.
Assess the surface separately from the substance, since they are different findings.
Assess all three compartments, which means reviewing the axial plane for the patellofemoral joint.
Assess the subchondral plate and marrow alongside, because the two change together.
